title: Models & fallback
lead: Choose for each component: local or API, which API service, which local model, whether to fall back automatically, and the order to try when you want another take. These are the global defaults; changes made in a step's side panel only affect that one component.

presets.title: Presets
presets.switched: Switched to {{name}}. Components you changed by hand stay as they are.

desc.quality: Use the best API wherever there is one; local models only as fallback.
desc.balanced: Drafts and reruns run locally; the API makes the final version when you adopt. Money goes mostly into the take you keep.
desc.cheap: Local wherever possible; fall back to the cheapest API only when local fails.
desc.local: Never calls an API. Components without a local version (3D world) are skipped.

cost.quality: Estimate: mostly H3 API, about $30 per finished minute
cost.cheap: Estimate: below Balanced, depending on how often it falls back
cost.local: No API cost, only power and time

services.title: Services
services.rescan: Scan this machine again and install what is missing
services.note: Services without a key are skipped by automatic fallback and by Try another. Writing models all use the OpenAI-compatible API: a new model works once you enter its base URL and model name, no code change needed.
services.mediaLater: Keys for image, video and voice services are added here when those models are connected.

key.title: {{name}} API key
key.lead: The key is stored only in this computer's system keychain: never in the database or logs, and it is not shown again.
key.envNote: This key comes from the environment or .env; change it there to remove it.
key.docs: Get a key from the provider

fallback.title: When something fails

hint.after: On a problem it switches to the fallback model and keeps going; the result and the reason are kept in the history and run log.
hint.ask: On a problem it pauses the step and asks you: fall back, retry or skip.

fallback.budgetInvalid: The budget must be 0 or more.

table.label: Component settings
table.changed: Changed by hand; does not follow the preset
table.offNoLocal: No local version; this step is skipped
table.fallbackHint: Triggers on a local error, out of VRAM, a timeout, or QA failing several times in a row.
